definitions: A logical representation of data that is derived from one or more physical data sources but does not physically store the data itself.
A collection of data that appears as a single, unified set to users or applications, even though it may be distributed across various underlying systems.
examples: The analyst created a virtual data set to combine sales figures from different regions.
Accessing the virtual data set provided a real-time view of inventory.
Security policies were applied to the virtual data set, not the underlying databases.
